name: Noínden Ulad
sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Noínden Ulad is an Irish term that stands for the Ulstermen. The title is a cross-reference to the Debility of the Ulstermen. See that entry for the full account.
